Dream 2026-11-22 linked 4 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-30 · touches · "we build the first steps of a generic registry system" (Vignette 2026-10-30: the first steps of a generic registry system)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "I will register all my different repositories with my main mcp server" (Vignette 2026-10-30: packages and repositories are used in opposite directions)
- 2026-11-02 · touches · "establish a single server that can handle a set of known repos" (Vignette 2026-11-02: the registry is one server over known repositories, some read-only)
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "we now have our local mcp server able to serve multiple repos" (A repo just for transcripts, addressable, because muSrs is already big (2026-11-05))
